pipeline.noPipelinesHint: Create a pipeline to automate multi-step tasks
pipeline.whatIsBody: A pipeline is a fixed sequence of workflow templates (prompts) that run one after another — like a CI/CD line for agent work. Use it when the same multi-step process repeats for every feature or ticket.
pipeline.whatIsStep1: Create workflow templates first (tab Workflows) — each template is one step’s instructions.
pipeline.whatIsStep2: Add at least two steps here in order: Step 1 runs, then Step 2, and so on.
pipeline.whatIsStep3: Press Run on a pipeline to start; advance each step when the agent run finishes (Mission Control does not auto-detect completion unless you integrate it).
pipeline.stepsSectionHint: Pick a template per step. Minimum two steps. Drag order with ↑↓.
pipeline.diagramHint: Steps run in order; arrows show hand-off to the next template.
pipeline.defaultPipelineHelper: Fills a two-step sequence from your first templates (by id). Edit order and templates below.
pipeline.defaultPipelineNeedsTemplates: Create at least two workflow templates first, then load the default pipeline.
pipeline.defaultPipelineDescription: Two templates in sequence — adjust templates, order, and parameters as needed.
pipeline.canvasControlsHint: Scroll to zoom, drag the canvas to pan — same controls as the delivery flow board.

deliveryFlow.title: Delivery flow (JIRA handoffs)
deliveryFlow.subtitle: Define stages left-to-right: who acts, optional JIRA status, and whether work is pushed forward or pulled by the next actor.
deliveryFlow.journeyIntro: Mirror your JIRA or Azure board: each stage maps to a column name (status). Pick one stage as the trigger — when a backlog item enters that column, Mission Control treats the delivery journey as started. Link one or more agents per column and write instructions they follow on each card; reacting the moment the status changes will use webhooks or polling in a later release.
deliveryFlow.descriptionPlaceholder: How this map relates to your board
deliveryFlow.emptyStages: Add stages to mirror your board. This is documentation and alignment — wire to JIRA in Work pipeline.
deliveryFlow.placeholderHint: Use {{paramName}} in stage names or JIRA columns. Values come from Parameters (workspace), defaults from the table below, then pipeline/step overrides when running agent pipelines.
deliveryFlow.parameterDefinitionsHint: Declare keys your client fills in the Parameters panel. Defaults apply before workspace values.
deliveryFlow.noParameters: No declared parameters yet — add keys to document what each tenant must configure.
deliveryFlow.previewHint: Shows JIRA column / label after substituting defaults + workspace Parameters.
deliveryFlow.boardSubtitle: Each column is a board status and the agent who owns that stage. Link an agent from your squad, or type a role. Arrows show how work moves (push vs pull).
deliveryFlow.triggerStageHint: Choose the stage whose JIRA / Azure column starts the flow (e.g. Ready for development). The text must match the status you sync from Work pipeline.
deliveryFlow.triggerAutomationHint: Listening for status changes in real time (webhooks or scheduled sync) is not wired yet — this choice is stored so agents and future automation know when the journey begins.
deliveryFlow.noAgentsForSquad: No agents in the workspace yet — add agents under Agents, then return here.
deliveryFlow.agentInstructionsPlaceholder: Checklist, questions for the human, acceptance hints…
deliveryFlow.agentInstructionsHint: Shown in Mission Control for this column and intended for future card threads so agents can ask the assignee for clarifications.
deliveryFlow.diagramHint: Interactive canvas (React Flow): zoom, pan, minimap. Click a stage to edit below. Edge color and label show push vs pull between stages.
deliveryFlow.defaultFlowHelper: Replaces stages with a standard linear board; you can rename, reorder, and link agents before saving.
deliveryFlow.selectStageHint: Click a node above to edit column mapping, agent squad, card instructions, or handoff.
deliveryFlow.defaultFlowDescription: Linear JIRA-style stages from backlog to done — adjust to match your board.
deliveryFlow.canvasControlsHint: Scroll to zoom, drag the background to pan. Use the minimap and corner controls to navigate.
